name: Error-guided Guided Sampling
definition: A densification strategy that identifies low-SSIM training views, computes a pixel-wise error mask, processes it in 16×16 patches to estimate median depth and filter error regions, and spawns new Gaussians only in high-error areas while avoiding edge artifacts and overlapping placements.
summary: Error-guided Guided Sampling is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that spawns new primitives in high-error regions identified by global view-based analysis, rather than relying on local gradients.
